method.description: Ratings measure the length of selected mathematical exposition, including substantive supporting arguments, rather than intrinsic difficulty or discovery effort. Every detailed result and overview group is rated. Group counts combine their selected passages, counting overlapping source lines once. Alternative proofs, Lean code and compiler logs are excluded; published background is cited rather than expanded. Compressed exposition remains compressed in this measure.

counting: Whitespace-delimited words in the inclusive source-line ranges listed below, including displayed formulas and the definitions and scope qualifications in those ranges. Counts describe the selected exposition, not a formal proof-size measure. Each source is identified by its SHA-256 digest. Group selections are the union of their result selections, with overlapping lines counted once.
